definitions.explanation: A collective term referring to multiple countries, often used in formal or diplomatic contexts. Common in news, academic writing, and historical texts.
In historical contexts, refers to the various provinces or domains of pre-modern Japan.

examples.japanese: ヨーロッパ{諸国|しょこく}を{訪問|ほうもん}した。
{近隣|きんりん}{諸国|しょこく}との{関係|かんけい}を{強化|きょうか}する。
{先進|せんしん}{諸国|しょこく}は{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}への{対策|たいさく}を{急|いそ}いでいる。
examples.english: Developed nations are stepping up measures against climate change.

examples.japanese: {武士|ぶし}が{諸国|しょこく}を{旅|たび}した。
examples.english: The samurai traveled through various provinces.

examples.japanese: {諸国|しょこく}の{大名|だいみょう}が{江戸|えど}に{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Lords from various domains gathered in Edo.

examples.japanese: {修行僧|しゅぎょうそう}が{諸国|しょこく}を{巡|めぐ}り{歩|ある}いた{記録|きろく}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: Records remain of monks who traveled on pilgrimages through various provinces.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly used in news and official documents. Often preceded by a geographic or descriptive modifier: ヨーロッパ{諸国|しょこく}, アジア{諸国|しょこく}, {先進|せんしん}{諸国|しょこく}, {近隣|きんりん}{諸国|しょこく}. In historical contexts, refers to the old provinces of Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先進|せんしん}{諸国|しょこく} (developed nations)
- {近隣|きんりん}{諸国|しょこく} (neighboring countries)
- アジア{諸国|しょこく} (Asian countries)
- {諸国|しょこく}を{歴訪|れきほう}する (to tour various countries)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {各国|かっこく}: each country, every nation — emphasizes individual countries rather than the group
- {国々|くにぐに}: countries — a less formal alternative
